page.metaDescription: Private investigation, security, corporate risk, NRI verification and forensic examination across Kolkata and West Bengal.
page.title: Security and investigation services in West Bengal
page.description: Five practices, one standard: every engagement is scoped around the outcome you need, handled discreetly, and carried out within Indian law.

items.title: Private Investigation
items.shortDescription: Confidential matrimonial, pre-matrimonial and personal enquiries, documented so you can act on them.
items.description: Discreet investigation for individuals and families — matrimonial and pre-matrimonial enquiries, tracing, and personal or civil matters. Every assignment is handled under confidentiality, carried out within Indian law, and reported with the evidence behind each finding rather than the finding alone.
items.metaDescription: Confidential private investigation in Kolkata and West Bengal - matrimonial, pre-matrimonial, tracing and personal enquiries, handled within the law.

items.title: Security Services
items.shortDescription: Vetted, trained guards and supervisors, backed by supervision and on-site security audits.
items.description: Screened and trained security personnel for residential societies, commercial premises, warehouses and events across West Bengal — supported by active supervision, shift auditing, and site assessments that find the gaps before anyone else does.
items.metaDescription: Trained, vetted security guards and supervisors for societies, offices, warehouses and events across West Bengal, with site audits and supervision.

items.title: Corporate Investigation & Risk
items.shortDescription: Due diligence, employee verification and fraud enquiries for decisions that need evidence.
items.description: Investigative support for businesses — pre-employment and vendor background verification, partner and counterparty due diligence, internal fraud and misconduct enquiries, and risk assessment ahead of a deal or an appointment. Findings are documented to stand up in an internal process or before a regulator.
items.metaDescription: Due diligence, employee and vendor background verification, internal fraud enquiries and risk assessment for businesses in Kolkata and West Bengal.

items.title: NRI Services
items.shortDescription: On-ground verification and representation in India for non-resident Indians.
items.description: Local eyes for non-resident Indians who need something checked on the ground at home — pre-matrimonial and family background verification, property title and possession checks, tenant verification, and welfare visits to elderly relatives. Reports come back with photographs and documentation, so distance stops being a disadvantage.
items.metaDescription: On-ground checks in India for NRIs - pre-matrimonial, property and tenant verification, and family welfare visits, reported with documentation.

items.title: Forensic Investigation
items.shortDescription: Questioned document, handwriting and digital evidence examination that survives scrutiny.
items.description: Technical examination for matters that turn on the evidence itself — questioned documents, handwriting and signature comparison, and the collection and handling of digital evidence. The work draws on decades in government forensic science and is documented so the method, not only the conclusion, can be reviewed.
items.metaDescription: Questioned documents, handwriting and signature comparison, and digital evidence handling in Kolkata, documented so the method can be reviewed.
